_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the integrity judge returned them, round 2; each why abridged by the run.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Grade holds and the deck stays dark; 5 the best frame and 9 a real subject; 4's mannequin and hidden stand base, the cover's boxes and void, 7's grey strata and dot rig, 8's flat stripes, 2's stub.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, one accent; motif evolves; 7 sits outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; frame 3 maps a share of injuries onto a share of floor area; slide 1 drops c7's modal; caption hook and cover headline are universals without their set; AJOT republication not visible in the first comment; c3 not listed; 'drawn to illustrate' absent on 2 and 6.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where clear; no body or deadline; jobs rest on c9.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover and 2 pay; 6 turns; 4 and 5 both on c26; 7 could move; flat close.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Lateral, racks and gate repeat no. 68; ten of twenty repeats no. 69; floodlit world repeats nos. 59 and 67.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: White mannequin before a cabin; stand crammed right, base hidden.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Stand rising from lit slips at centre, the person at its base outside the gate.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey noise strata; thin lateral; dot rig.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Near-black strata with one raked caliche layer, a raised string, a rig pin with height.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Rounded blocks; blurred shaft; orbs for a mast.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pipe with a tool joint and specular line, die pads, loom, a lit lattice.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat stripes; flat bands; no casts.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower key elevation, raised band edges, box ends on the left.
The full stand rising out of the top edge.
